findings.title: TidalHealth to close rural Primary Care Center in Federalsburg
findings.exact_supporting_passage: On Sunday, November 15th, the clinic will shut their doors in Federalsburg for good.
findings.access_consequences: TidalHealth Primary Care in Federalsburg has a confirmed November 15 closure; patients are being connected to alternate TidalHealth primary care sites in Bridgeville, Seaford, Delmar, and Georgetown. Local reporting notes increased travel burden and limited transportation for some residents. Closure not yet effective at observation.
findings.affected_population: Primary-care patients in Federalsburg and surrounding Caroline/North Dorchester county communities, particularly residents with limited transportation.
findings.discovery_note: Published Nov 2 and newly surfaced in this hourly recall, NOT newly announced/implemented in the 22:49–23:46 PST interval. Three recent prior verified heartbeat exclusion lists did not reference this closure. Production deduplication not independently verified; pending editorial/dedupe review.
